name: Reykjavik, Golden Circle + Blue Lagoon, Iceland
tagline: Classic Iceland: geysers, waterfalls, lagoons, northern lights
whyParents: Short nonstop to another world: geysers, black sand beaches, warm lagoons, and a shot at the aurora.

costPP.flightsBasis: Icelandair NYC-KEF nonstop: icelandair.com lists Dec 5 to 17 2026 round trips from $446 (Economy Light, no checked bag). Economy Standard for Dec 12 to 18 estimated ~$600. No PHL nonstop; PLAY ceased flying Sept 2025.
costPP.lodgingBasis: Downtown Reykjavik 2BR apartment ~$330/night all-in (cleaning, fees, VAT, lodging tax) x 5 nights (land Dec 13 AM) = ~$1,650 / 4. Estimate; no December 2BR data found.

flight.routing: JFK-KEF nonstop (Icelandair; EWR-KEF also listed year-round). Out Sat Dec 12 evening, lands Sun ~6:30am; home Fri Dec 18 afternoon.
flight.notes: Book Economy Standard (bag + seat). Icelandair partners with Alaska Mileage Plan. United/Delta KEF routes are summer only. Bookable on Capital One Travel.

weather.precip: Rain, sleet or snow most days; strong wind common

stay: Downtown Reykjavik near Laugavegur: walkable, tour pickups at the door
getAround: No car: Flybus from KEF, guided minibus tours for Golden Circle, South Coast and aurora. Self-drive (4x4 SUV) means icy roads, 2.5h each way to Vik.
entry: US passport valid 3+ months past departure. Schengen; EES biometric check on arrival. ETIAS not yet required.
events: Yule Lads: first arrives the night of Dec 11 to 12, one more each night to Dec 24
Hjartatorg Christmas market weekends in December (2026 dates not yet posted)
Hafnarfjordur Christmas Village expected Dec 1 to 23 2026 (based on prior years)
pros: Under 6h nonstop from JFK or EWR
Warm geothermal lagoons in snowy darkness
cons: Storms can cancel tours and close roads

itinerary.title: Overnight flight
itinerary.plan: Sat evening JFK to Keflavik; sleep on board, land about 6:30am Sunday.

itinerary.title: Reykjavik + Christmas lights
itinerary.plan: Flybus to town, nap, stroll Laugavegur and the Old Harbour under Christmas lights.
itinerary.eat: Lamb soup at Icelandic Street Food

itinerary.title: Golden Circle
itinerary.plan: Guided tour: Thingvellir rift, Strokkur geyser, Gullfoss. Aurora tour after dark if skies clear.

itinerary.title: South Coast to Vik
itinerary.plan: Long guided day: Seljalandsfoss, Skogafoss, Reynisfjara black sand beach. Stay back from waves.
itinerary.eat: Fish and chips at Smidjan Brugghus, Vik

itinerary.title: Hallgrimskirkja + Sky Lagoon
itinerary.plan: Church tower view at sunrise (11am), Harpa, then sunset soak at Sky Lagoon.
itinerary.eat: Hot dog at Baejarins Beztu Pylsur

itinerary.title: Perlan + aurora night two
itinerary.plan: Perlan ice cave and glacier exhibit, Christmas market, backup northern lights tour.

itinerary.title: Blue Lagoon, fly home
itinerary.plan: Transfer with bags to Blue Lagoon (near airport), soak, then afternoon flight to JFK.

unverified: Icelandair JFK (vs EWR) frequency in December 2026 and exact flight times
Economy Standard fare for Dec 12 to 18 (only Economy Light 'from' fare seen)
Blue Lagoon status: closed repeatedly during Reykjanes eruptions; check before booking, Sky Lagoon is the backup
2026 Christmas market dates in Reykjavik and Hafnarfjordur

name: Arenal + Manuel Antonio, Costa Rica
tagline: Volcano, hot springs, sloths, Pacific beaches
whyParents: Rainforest bridges, volcano hot springs and monkeys on the beach, about 5.5 hours nonstop.

costPP.flightsBasis: United EWR-SJO nonstop: united.com lists Dec 2026 round trips from $587; Kayak/Cheapflights show United nonstops ~$465 to $468 late Nov/Dec (likely basic). Main Cabin Dec 12 to 18 ~$600.
costPP.lodgingBasis: La Fortuna 2BR house ~$200/night all-in x 3 + Manuel Antonio 2BR condo ~$330/night all-in x 3 = ~$1,590 / 4. Listing 'from' rates $145 to $435; no December data.

flight.routing: EWR-SJO nonstop (United). Alt: JetBlue JFK-SJO nonstop (Dec 2026 one-ways from $202).
flight.notes: AA PHL-LIR nonstop is Saturday-only, so no Friday return. Delta JFK-LIR starts Dec 19, too late. AA via MIA is the 1-stop option.

weather.precip: Dry season starting on Pacific coast; Arenal still has frequent showers

stay: La Fortuna town (volcano views), then Manuel Antonio hillside near park
getAround: Rent full-size 4x4 SUV (Toyota Fortuner class) at SJO. Drives: SJO to La Fortuna ~3h, La Fortuna to Manuel Antonio ~4h, back to SJO ~3h.
entry: US passport valid for the stay; no visa for tourism. Proof of onward ticket may be asked.
events: Festival de la Luz parade in San Jose Sat Dec 12 2026 (new route, Plaza de la Democracia to Paseo Colon); itinerary heads to Arenal instead
Manuel Antonio National Park closed Tuesdays; timed tickets online only via SINAC, book ahead
pros: Volcano hot springs and easy beaches
cons: Arenal clouds often hide the volcano
Pricey park entries and tours add up

itinerary.title: Land SJO, drive to Arenal
itinerary.plan: Pick up SUV, 3 hour scenic drive to La Fortuna, sunset volcano view.
itinerary.eat: Casado at Soda La Hormiga, La Fortuna

itinerary.title: Hanging bridges + volcano trails
itinerary.plan: Morning bird walk on Mistico Hanging Bridges, afternoon Arenal Volcano National Park lava trails.
itinerary.eat: Lunch at Mistico's Restaurante Puente Colgante

itinerary.title: Waterfall + hot springs
itinerary.plan: Hike 500 steps to La Fortuna Waterfall and swim, then evening at Tabacon hot springs.

itinerary.title: Drive to Manuel Antonio
itinerary.plan: About 4 hours to the Pacific coast (park closed today, Tuesday). Sunset on Playa Espadilla.

itinerary.title: Manuel Antonio National Park
itinerary.plan: 7am guided walk for sloths and monkeys, then swim at Playa Manuel Antonio.

itinerary.title: Wildlife + beach day
itinerary.plan: Sloth tour or catamaran snorkel cruise, lazy afternoon at the beach.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.plan: Leave by 7am, 3 hour drive to SJO, return SUV, midday flight to Newark.
